//: Who exists in staging, and what they may do. Loaded by app-staging.yml
before the e2e suite runs, idempotently, on every deploy — so a pool or a
table recreated tomorrow is restored by the next run rather than found a
week later as a mystery app regression.
ADDING A TEST USER IS AN EDIT TO THIS FILE. No script run, no secret, no
slot in e2e/support/env.ts. That is the whole point: the tenancy model is
about several people with different reach, so a suite that can only ever
sign in as one of them cannot test the thing the model exists for —
may_see_case, access_all_cases, another firm's case answering 404, or the
409 that stops a firm removing its last administrator.
THE ADDRESSES ARE COMMITTED AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. Every one ends in
.test, a reserved TLD (RFC 2606) that can never be a real mailbox — which
is exactly what e2e/CLAUDE.md's no-addresses rule protects against.
Nothing is mailed to them either (the loader passes MessageAction
SUPPRESS). Keeping them here is what lets the suite and the seeder agree
on who exists by reading one file rather than drifting through two sets of
secrets. A real mailbox must never appear here.
The password is the ONE secret left, shared by every account: these are
throwaway identities in an environment with no customer data, and one
value that rotates cleanly beats one per person that rotates by hand.
The loader sets it on every run, so rotating the secret converges the
accounts instead of locking the suite out.
`handle` is how e2e/support/env.ts names a user; it is ignored by the API's
own parser. Keep handles stable — a spec refers to them.
Deliberately NOT an admin and NOT access-all-cases: the pair with
the row above is what makes per-case linking and the
FIRM_ADMINISTRATION refusals testable at all.
A SECOND FIRM, with one person in it, and it earns its place: cross-
tenant isolation is the one property that cannot be tested from inside
a single firm. ADR 0009 has another firm's case answering 404 rather
than 403, and nothing else in the suite can tell those apart.
firms.name: Other Firm LLP
